text:
elaine: Hey team — prepping a sandbox webhook test for AcmeHW marketplace integration. Need a quick sanity check on payloads + replay tests before the partner dry-run tomorrow 10:00 PST. Key checks: usage shapes, entitlement activation events, signature verification.

tonY: Do we have a canonical test payload? I can run a replay harness but need the curl example and the expected signature header.

vikram: Uploaded samples to s3: s3://redwood-partner-tests/acmehw/webhook-samples.json — contains: hourly-usage, minute-usage, zero-usage (heartbeat), entitlement-activate, duplicate-delivery. I also added expected ledger delta notes in the README.

elaine: Helpful. Important notes for team: partner will include fields: `idempotent_id`, `device_id`, `usage_units`, `timestamp`. They send `X-Partner-Signature` header using sha256 HMAC. Example curl to hit sandbox: 
```
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.com/marketplace/webhook \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Partner-Signature: sha256=abcdef..." \n  -d @sample_hourly.json
```
Sample minimal payload (from samples file):
```json
{"idempotent_id":"evt-20250322-01","device_id":"acme-123","usage_units":120,"timestamp":1679596800,"event_type":"usage"}
```
Please assert idempotency and signature. Also validate we don't double-credit on replay unless we opt-in.

marketplace-bot: deploy: webhook-sandbox updated -> version v2025-03-22. Tests run: 12 passed, 1 flaky (timestamp-ms vs s). See CI logs: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/2345

tony: I'll run replays from the harness at 08:00 PT and attach logs here. One request: can we toggle a `replay_mode` flag to allow duplicate deliveries for testing so partner can see "what-if" credits?

vikram: Yes — use the replay endpoint `POST /internal/replay?replay_mode=allow_duplicates`. Note: partner sometimes sends epoch in ms; we've added heuristics to normalize ms->s. Tests include both. Also watch out for timezone mislabels — samples include UTC and PST-tagged timestamps.

elaine: Great. Tony — please ping partner-success to send the sample payloads and the curl example. @sam FYI — entitlements edgecases (activation then immediate usage) are in the README; would love a quick look.

sam: Will review entitlement activation ordering and the ledger delta notes after Tony posts the replay logs. I can run a quick reconciliation script against the sandbox ledger.

tony: :thumbsup: scheduling replays now. Will post logs + `replay_id` here once finished.
